identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Study for the Efficacy and Safety of Ropeginterferon Alfa-2b in Adult COVID-19 Patients With Comorbidities
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open Label, Control Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Ropeginterferon Alfa-2b in Adult COVID-19 Patients With Comorbidities

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy of subcutaneous ropeginterferon alfa 2b ( P1101 combined with standard of care (SOC) compared with standard care alone in adult COVID-19 patients with comorbidities.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a multi-center, open label, control study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ropeginterferon alfa-2b in the treatment of adult COVID-19 patients with comorbidities. Adult COVID-19 patient with the specific comorbidities and being non-responder to the other anti-SARS-CoV-2 drugs, i.e., remdesivir, nirmatrelvir/ritonavir, and molnupiravir, or the patients who is not suitable to receive the other anti-SARS-CoV-2 drugs by investigator's judgement and has positive result (Ct \<30) 14 days after the symptom onset of COVID-19 will be enrolled. The eligible patients will be randomized to receive the ropeginterferon alfa-2b plus SOC (study group) or to receive SOC alone (control group). For study group, a single dose of 250 μg ropeginterferon alfa-2b will be subcutaneous administrated at Day 1 visit. For patients who still have positive result (Ct \<30) in SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR at Day 15 and Day 29, the second dose of ropeginterferon alfa-2b at 350 μg and the third dose at 500 μg will be administered, respectively. For control group, patients will receive the SOC alone. The efficacy and safety of ropeginterferon alfa-2b will be evaluated.

armGroups.label: Study Group
armGroups.description: Treated with P1101 (Ropeginterferon alfa-2b) plus standard of care (SOC)

interventions.name: Ropeginterferon alfa-2b
interventions.description: A maximum of 3 doses of ropeginterferon alfa-2b will be given biweekly during the whole study period. A single dose of 250 μg ropeginterferon alfa-2b will be subcutaneous administrated at Day 1 visit. SARS-CoV-2 antigen test will be conducted at D15 and D29 visits. For patients who still have positive result in SARS-CoV-2 antigen test at Day 15 visit, the second dose of ropeginterferon alfa-2b at 350 μg will be subsequently administered at Day 15 visit. For patients who still have positive result in SARS-CoV-2 antigen test at Day 29 visit, the third dose of ropeginterferon alfa-2b at 500 μg will be administered at Day 29 visit.

interventions.name: SOC
interventions.description: SOC includes infection prevention and control measures, supportive care, dexamethasone, and antiviral agents. The SOC is based on the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control (CDC) guidance and investigator's discretion.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Time from randomization to the achievement of Ct value ≥30 in SARS-CoV-2 quantitative reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR)
primaryOutcomes.description: To compare the time from randomization to the achievement of Ct value ≥30 in SARS-CoV-2 quantitative RT-PCR between the Study and Control groups

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The proportion of patients who achieve Ct value ≥30 in quantitative SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR at Day 15, Day 29, and Day 43
secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of patients who achieve Ct value ≥30 in quantitative SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR at Day 15, 29, and 43, compared between the Study and Control groups

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change from randomization in the clinical status
secondaryOutcomes.description: The change from randomization in the clinical status of patient on WHO clinical progression scale at Day 15, 29, and 43, compared between the Study and Control groups
The change of SpO2 from randomization to Day 15, 29, and 43, compared between the Study and Control groups

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The occurrence and the accumulated duration (days) of supple-mental oxygen
secondaryOutcomes.description: To compare the occurrence and the accumulated duration (days) of supplemental oxygen between the Study and Control groups

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The occurrence and the accumulated duration (days) of mechanical ventilation
secondaryOutcomes.description: To compare the occurrence and the accumulated duration (days) of mechanical ventilation between the Study and Control groups
